records.source: Oh, don't mind me, I'm just doing a little shopping.#$e#If I don't browse the shops, I might miss the perfect decoration for our living room!
records.translation: O, huwag mo akong intindihin, namimili lang ako nang kaunti.#$e#Kung hindi ako titingin sa mga tindahan, baka hindi ko makita ang perpektong dekorasyon para sa sala natin!

records.source: Hey, @. Enjoying the heat?
records.translation: Hoy, @. Nasisiyahan ka ba sa init?

records.source: I was just wondering... If I lived here, instead of Stardew Valley, would my art look different?
records.translation: Naisip ko lang... Kung dito ako nakatira sa halip na sa Stardew Valley, magiging iba kaya ang sining ko?
records.englishResidueReason: Stardew Valley is the canonical retained game and place name.

records.source: I like this place. The weather reminds me of home.
records.translation: Gusto ko ang lugar na ito. Ipinapaalala sa akin ng panahon ang tahanan ko.

records.source: After a long, dark winter, this festival is a good way to revive everyone.
records.translation: Pagkatapos ng mahaba at madilim na taglamig, mabuting paraan ang pistang ito upang muling sumigla ang lahat.

records.source: All of this is possible because you fixed the bus, @! I can't thank you enough.
records.translation: Naging posible ang lahat ng ito dahil inayos mo ang bus, @! Hindi sapat ang pasasalamat ko.

records.source: Remember, today is the last day of the festival. We'll be back next year, though.
records.translation: Tandaan, ngayon ang huling araw ng pista. Babalik naman tayo sa susunod na taon.

records.source: I hitched a ride underneath the bus.#$e#You can't find this Calico Desert flavor anywhere else. Heheh...$h
records.translation: Nakilulan ako sa ilalim ng bus.#$e#Hindi mo matatagpuan saanman ang ganitong lasa ng Disyerto ng Calico. Heheh...$h

records.source: Hey, @. I was just thinking about milk.#$e#Would you ever try camel's milk? I've heard it's salty.
records.translation: Hoy, @. Iniisip ko lang ang tungkol sa gatas.#$e#Susubukan mo ba ang gatas ng kamelyo? Narinig kong maalat iyon.

records.source: I'm impressed with how well-trained these little racers are!$h
records.translation: Humahanga ako sa husay ng pagsasanay sa maliliit na mananakbong ito!$h

records.source: Hey, kid... You takin' the day off? It's nice to kick back every once in a while, isn't it?#$e#Yep... Even ol' Pam needs some sunlight on her skin now and then! Just wake me up before I turn into leather... Heheh.
records.translation: Hoy, bata... Nagpapahinga ka ba ngayon? Masarap ding magrelaks paminsan-minsan, hindi ba?#$e#Oo... Kahit ang matandang Pam ay kailangan ding maarawan paminsan-minsan! Gisingin mo lang ako bago maging katad ang balat ko... Heheh.

records.source: Thousands of years ago, this place was the homeland of an ancient civilization. I wonder what they were like?
records.translation: Libo-libong taon na ang nakararaan, tinubuang-bayan ang lugar na ito ng isang sinaunang kabihasnan. Ano kaya ang uri ng pamumuhay nila?

records.source: As a shopkeeper, I find it interesting to see how other people run their shops.#$e#*whisper* Don't tell Sandy, but my grocery selection blows hers out of the water!
records.translation: Bilang tindero, kawili-wili para sa akin na makita kung paano pinatatakbo ng iba ang kanilang mga tindahan.#$e#*bulong* Huwag mong sabihin kay Sandy, pero walang sinabi ang mga paninda niya sa pagpipilian ko!

records.source: Hey @. We're just chewing the fat over here. I don't see these guys very often, even though we're neighbors!
records.translation: Hoy, @. Nagkukuwentuhan lang kami rito. Hindi ko sila madalas makita kahit magkakapitbahay kami!

records.source: Hey, @. Check out my cactus. I'm trying to think of a name for him.#$e#Hmm... maybe '%name'?
records.translation: Hoy, @. Tingnan mo ang kaktus ko. Nag-iisip ako ng pangalan para sa kaniya.#$e#Hmm... baka '%name'?

records.source: This is probably the busiest time of the year for me! It's nice to be able to see everyone.
records.translation: Malamang ito ang pinakaabalang panahon ng taon para sa akin! Masayang makita ang lahat.

records.source: Hey. I'm just hanging out with this bird. She seems to like me.
records.translation: Hoy. Nagpapalipas-oras lang ako kasama ang ibong ito. Mukhang gusto niya ako.

records.source: I came here once when I was a kid... The only thing I remember is getting sick on the bus ride.
records.translation: Minsan akong pumunta rito noong bata pa ako... Ang tanging naaalala ko ay nasuka ako sa biyahe ng bus.

records.source: Mom, I'm bored!
records.translation: Nanay, nababagot ako!

records.source: Ah, nothing like the smell o' grilled shrimp on a warm day.
records.translation: Ah, walang katulad ang amoy ng inihaw na hipon sa mainit na araw.

records.source: Cactus Man: They're feeling shy right now. Come back later.
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Nahihiya sila ngayon. Bumalik ka mamaya.

records.source: Cactus Man: So, how's the little guy doing?
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Kumusta na ang munting kasama mo?

records.source: Cactus Man: Ah, yes... You look like someone who would appreciate what I'm offering.
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Ah, oo... Mukha kang taong magpapahalaga sa iniaalok ko.

records.source: Cactus Man: Oh, yes... I've got the perfect match for you.
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: O, oo... May perpektong kapareha ako para sa iyo.

records.source: Cactus Man: That look in your eye... it says: "I need a cactus, or I'm gonna burst".
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Ang tingin sa iyong mga mata... sinasabi nitong: "Kailangan ko ng kaktus, kung hindi ay sasabog ako".

records.source: Cactus Man: Are you ready to welcome a new cactus into your life?
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Handa ka na bang tanggapin ang bagong kaktus sa iyong buhay?

records.source: Cactus Man: I understand. They may be small, but accepting a cactus into your life is big responsibility. Come back when you're feeling ready.
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Nauunawaan ko. Maaaring maliit sila, ngunit malaking pananagutan ang pagtanggap ng kaktus sa iyong buhay. Bumalik ka kapag handa ka na.

records.source: Cactus Man: Great. Let's see...
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Mahusay. Tingnan natin...

records.source: Cactus Man: You don't have enough space... Come back after you've made some room.
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Wala kang sapat na puwang... Bumalik ka kapag nakapaglaan ka na ng lugar.

records.source: Cactus Man: Yes, he bears a striking resemblance to you, don't you agree?
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Oo, kapansin-pansin ang pagkakahawig niya sa iyo, hindi ba?

records.source: Cactus Man: This one's a little shy, but I know you'll become friends in no time.
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Medyo mahiyain ang isang ito, pero alam kong mabilis kayong magiging magkaibigan.

records.source: Cactus Man: Oh, yes... it's a match made in heaven.
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: O, oo... itinadhana kayong magkatugma.

records.source: Cactus Man: I won't say why... but this one is the perfect match for you.
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Hindi ko sasabihin kung bakit... pero perpektong kapareha mo ang isang ito.

records.source: Cactus Man: This one's got a strange look, but it suits you.
records.translation: Lalaking Kaktus: Kakaiba ang hitsura ng isang ito, pero bagay sa iyo.

records.source: The shop isn't open. Come back later.
records.translation: Hindi bukas ang tindahan. Bumalik ka mamaya.

records.source: Accept
records.translation: Tanggapin

records.source: Decline
records.translation: Tanggihan

records.source: Willy's Challenge: Catch 3 Sandfish.
records.translation: Hamon ni Willy: Manghuli ng 3 Sandfish.
records.englishResidueReason: Sandfish is the fictional fish name used consistently in existing Filipino quest text.

records.source: Willy's Challenge
records.translation: Hamon ni Willy

records.source: Willy has challenged you to catch 3 Sandfish.
records.translation: Hinamon ka ni Willy na manghuli ng 3 Sandfish.
records.englishResidueReason: Sandfish is the fictional fish name used consistently in existing Filipino quest text.
